title: The Erdős–Szemerédi sunflower conjecture
summary: A Lean formalization of the main vector bound, the explicit set-family bound, and the no-prefactor conjecture in Proof of the Erdős-Szemerédi sunflower conjecture by Matija Bucić, Fankang He, and Hyunwoo Lee (arXiv:2610.26686). The complete proof development uses Mathlib and contains no unresolved proof holes or nonstandard axioms.
